identityPolicy: Bind this immutable Linux snapshot and three stable worker records. No claim that all current repository sources are unchanged; the captured NumberEdit src and core test were separately hash-checked.

firefoxDisabledRepair.visualObservation: Both new Firefox light/dark disabled capture pairs are visibly muted disabled, not the normal read-only brightness from the old failed candidate.

steps: Real scene-padding click after Tab with padding hit assertion.

Before screenshot assert selector value, scene data-state, and input disabled again.

observations.values: Scientific value 1.25×10³ and exponent 3 are discernible in all captured Apple fields. Labels, help, borders and muted lock steppers remain complete in scene crops.
observations.crossEngine: Chromium, Firefox and WebKit font shapes differ and were independently viewed; no new definite visible collision or glyph clipping established. No cross-engine pixel equality inferred.
observations.darkDisabled: Disabled dark controls are dim; no contrast ratio or focus compliance claimed from these PNGs.
observations.lockBehavior: Native passed assertions and runtime flags remain separate from manual pixels; no disabled approval is based on filenames alone.
observations.noMotionClaim: No video/* attachment in native batch; no full video playback or derived frames.
